notes.education_specializations: Field-of-study is extracted from free-text descriptions, which only HaHuJobs postings have — EthioJobs postings contribute to each level's total but rarely to a specific field.
notes.employer_type: Private / Public / NGO is a keyword heuristic on the employer's own name, not a verified registry lookup.
notes.critical_skills: A sub-sector or role only appears here once at least 3 of its postings state a skills_required value, so a top-3 list is never built from a single posting.
